jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Examplecorp builds scheduling software for clinics. We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to design and run the services behind our booking platform.</p><h3>What you will do</h3><ul><li>Design and build APIs in Node.js and TypeScript</li><li>Model data in PostgreSQL and keep queries fast</li><li>Run services on Kubernetes with Docker and Terraform</li><li>Review code and mentor other engineers</li></ul><h3>What we expect</h3><ul><li>Five years of backend experience</li><li>Comfort with distributed systems and on-call work</li><li>Clear written communication</li></ul><p>Salary: €85,000 - €105,000 per year. Hybrid: two days a week in our Berlin office. Apply on our careers page.</p>

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.content: <p>Examplecorp is looking for a Product Designer to shape how clinics book appointments. You will own research, flows and visual design in Figma, and work closely with engineers who build in React and TypeScript.</p><h3>What you will do</h3><ul><li>Run interviews with clinic staff and patients</li><li>Design flows and prototypes in Figma</li><li>Ship polished interfaces together with engineering</li></ul><p>This is a fully remote role open to candidates across Europe.</p>

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern
jobs.content: <p>A six month internship in our engineering team. You will pair with senior engineers, write tests, fix bugs and build a small feature in Python and Django against a PostgreSQL database. We teach you our review process and how we run services in production. You should be studying computer science or a related subject and be curious about how real systems behave when they fail.</p><p>The internship is on-site in our Berlin office.</p>
